# Hunter System

> A free, gamified productivity app: your timetable becomes a daily quest log, habits earn XP, and you rank up from E to S while racing friends on a weekly leaderboard.

- [Sign up / log in](https://hunters-system.vercel.app/login): create an account and build your timetable
- Public hunter profiles live at `https://hunters-system.vercel.app/h/<hunter name>`
